statement: Migrate dynamic system-table write callers off raw SQL writes and default logs load: convert write-ack-visibility.js to appendDiagnosticMarker + SELECT readback, move default user mixed-load in load-generator.js and scenario-config.js from logs to provisioned user_load_logs, provision user_load_logs and record fixed system-log diagnostic markers across the 7 default mixed-load scenarios, and remove logs fallbacks from rolling-restart.js and table-distribution-helpers.

constraints.statement: Keep write-ack-visibility.js as a log-propagation scenario, replace raw INSERT INTO logs with appendDiagnosticMarker, and retain SELECT visibility checks and convergence gates.

Move default user mixed-load in load-generator.js to user_load_logs, provision user_load_logs before load in the 7 default mixed-load scenarios while preserving all 4 operation types and acknowledged-write tracking, and record fixed appendDiagnosticMarker + SELECT readback on logs across fault/recovery.
Remove capability-missing and default table fallbacks to logs in rolling-restart.js, scenario-config.js, and table-distribution-helpers.
